notes.title: Graduate Battle: 1,000 Core Words for the Exam!
notes.content:
Since I’m also using this app myself, I just couldn’t wait to share it—so here’s an early release of the current version!

What’s inside so far:

The core 1,000 words for the postgraduate exam (courtesy of SomeSeafood)

Some tricky look-alike words

Plans for the future (really coming!):

Adding even more vocabulary

Support for selecting different word lists

After I finish my own exam at the end of 2025, I’ll be adding even more fun content and characters!

Thanks for trying it out! Feel free to join me in studying and let’s grind hard together!

[i]—— The developer (also a grad exam taker) coding away live[/i]
